title: heterotheca villosa
intro: Heterotheca villosa, commonly known as hairy false goldeneye or hairy heterotheca, is a flowering plant in the daisy family, native to eastern North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Heterotheca villosa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and other phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include promoting wound healing, reducing fever, and soothing sore throats, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
